overview: Lantern Run is a compact collection-and-navigation game presented as a 2D garden. Pick up four golden lanterns, route around the garden walls and avoid a moving pink patrol before reaching the teal exit. The player starts with three hearts, so repeated contact can end the run.
rules: Collect all four lanterns before crossing into the exit area.
Walls block movement; plan a route through their openings.
A patrol contact removes a heart, followed by a short damage cooldown; losing all three hearts loses the run.
Reach the exit with every lantern collected to win.
controls: K saves; L loads/resumes; R restarts; M toggles sound.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
